creator: Alexander Terp
description: https://github.com/amterp/tai/issues/14 (open). Installing a Codex profile with read-only reviewer delegates prints "Codex agents have no tool allowlist, so 'tools' was not installed" once per delegate on every install. The only fix the warning offers, features: {shell_tool: false}, breaks a reviewer that needs its shell for git diff and rg. Codex expresses "reads and runs commands, never edits" with sandbox_mode = "read-only", but the adapter only checks features (internal/adapter/codex/codex.go:217), so native.codex.sandbox_mode does not silence the warning. Accept it as an answer when the delegate's tools exclude edits.
title: Codex adapter: let sandbox_mode answer the 'tools' warning for read-only delegates
